title: Safe parking sites for people living in cars
summary: Bill 133 had no vote yet as of October 23, when the recording ended at a recess. It would let vehicles that are not fully registered join the safe parking pilot and expand the county properties people may use. An amendment lets the county approve cooking at sites.

timeline.text: The recording ends at a ten-minute recess, with no vote yet on Bill 133.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: The vice chair asked for a copy of the department's rules for the site.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: A member said she wants to see progress a year from now because this is a pilot.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: Bill 133 would let vehicles that are not fully registered take part in the safe parking pilot.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: A testifier for a group serving houseless families said Bill 133 would let vehicles that are not fully registered join the safe parking pilot.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: A member said the director stressed the urgency of a managed temporary site while the permanent site is finished.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: An amendment lets the county approve cooking at sites, such as with food trucks.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: A member said Bill 133 expands the county properties where people may temporarily live in vehicles.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: A testifier asked about safe parking for people in need near the police station at the tech park.
timeline.body: County Council Housing and Land Use Committee

timeline.text: The chair said the bill will get non-substantive (wording-only) cleanup for Friday.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: Members can call the deputy corporation counsel with liability questions before Friday.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: Detailed liability questions would need an executive session (a closed-door discussion) or private calls before Friday.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The site will offer portable toilets, hand washing stations and drinking water.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The director said she will tell members when the security agreement is finalized.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: People who turn down all options will not be allowed to stay in the current roadside area.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The public can email site or program ideas to the director at director.hc@co.maui.hi.us.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: A separate permanent safe parking site in Kahuluʻi is still moving forward.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The pilot is expected to run six months at first.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: If the bill passes Friday and the site is finished this week, moving people could start next week.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The county plans a temporary site for people now living in vehicles along the road.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The director expects the site to serve 50 to 60 people.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The director said the site aims to keep people safer, away from traffic and its danger.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The director said the site will have private security around the clock.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: Deferral of the safe parking pilot bill: The chair deferred the safe parking bill item.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The director confirmed no cooking will be allowed, but nonprofits may bring food.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The director said the pilot will take about 50 people.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: A staff member invited members to call before Friday's second reading with liability questions instead of holding an executive session (a closed-door discussion).
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The director said the temporary site will have 24-hour security.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: Another testifier asked about liability if insurance and safety checks are waived.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: A staff member said the ordinance requires the council to review it within 12 months after a pilot starts.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The committee discussed a bill for a pilot program that would let people sleep in their vehicles at a county site.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The director said the six-month pilot clock starts when people are moved to the site.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: Another testifier asked the council to slow down and work with the people who will use the program.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: A Hawaiʻi Public Housing Authority board member said the bill removes transparency.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The director said people who do not join the pilot will be offered other shelter or treatment options.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: A testifier said he met a woman with three small children living in a vehicle.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: A testifier said the proposed site has no stores or gas stations nearby.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: One testifier asked the County to consider county parks, which already have toilets and water.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: A county lawyer said administrative rules (written procedures) take time and cannot be ready before the pilot programs start.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The director said the department will work with the Office of Communications to clarify the site plans for the public.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: A county lawyer said her office would be happy to work on draft rules as the pilot project moves forward.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: A county lawyer said the bill would allow other county-owned or managed parcels to be used, not just parking lots.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The director said removing the old rules language is enough, without writing a separate exemption.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The vice chair spoke of a dire need, citing a rise in people sleeping outside or in vehicles from 285 to 398.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: A deputy corporation counsel (county attorney) said the changes allow living in vehicles 24 hours a day, not only 7 p.m. to 7 a.m.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The director said the temporary site would check people's ties to Maui County using a homeless data system and police records.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: No vote was taken because this was a Rule 7B discussion only.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: A bill would expand where people living in vehicles can stay on county property and remove some entry requirements.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The chair said a 2022 law created a pilot project letting houseless people stay in their vehicles at certain county parking lots.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The bill is set for second and final reading on Friday.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: This was a Rule 7B discussion, so no legislative action was taken.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The bill would let more county properties be used for temporary living in vehicles.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The chair said there is an urgent need to address houselessness while keeping the public safe.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The committee discussed Bill 133 (2026), which amends Chapter 10.76 of the Maui County Code.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: A County director said the temporary site will run 24 hours, with a shuttle to the transit hub.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: A County director said staff will help safe parking participants get an ID or driver's license.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: A County attorney said sites under the ordinance would have to be county controlled in some form.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: Acting on the bill lets the County move ahead with a temporary safe parking site for unsheltered people being relocated.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: The bill removes driver's license, vehicle registration, and safety check requirements that some participants may lack.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: Bill 133 would allow more flexibility in the hours and conditions of each safe parking site.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: The resolution failed with four ayes and two noes.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: A council member said he would give the administration time to set up safe parking and a safe sleeping area.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: The Council voted 7–0 to amend the resolution's wording.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: The vice chair said the resolution was about safety for everyone, not about blaming people experiencing homelessness.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: Resolution 26-150 urged the administration to carry out a managed safe overnight parking project.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: A testifier said the phrase "immediate action" in the resolution was not defined.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: The committee deferred the item, meaning it was held for a later meeting.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The chair said another presentation is planned for July 27.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The director said the department does not yet have an overall homelessness plan but is working on one.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The director said none of the project money has been spent yet.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The department is talking with county lawyers and finance about its contracting options.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The director said access to water in central Maui has been a barrier for some sites.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The director said owners of large vacant commercial buildings did not respond or had concerns.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The director said the department is looking at undeveloped county-owned land, mostly in central Maui.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The founder of the group that first proposed safe parking said this is a completely different project.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: Designating the contractor's principal as a resource: Members agreed without objection to make the contractor's principal a resource for questions.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The director estimated about five months to get the site ready.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The department is re-checking the flooded site, starting with about four weeks of land survey mapping.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: Heavy flooding crossed the site, so the department is re-checking whether people could safely get out.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The contractor's 12-month agreement is six and a half months in.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: An extra $162,500 the council approved will go unspent because the contract was not changed.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: A notice to proceed, the go-ahead to start work, was issued December 11th, 2025.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The department director said the contract went to a company that proposed private land at 21 Hanson Road.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The chair said the committee will discuss a safe parking program on June 29th.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: Bills for a safe parking program and a $40,000 grant passed first reading 9–0.
timeline.body: County Council Meeting

timeline.text: The committee chair said the item would be deferred so it can be discussed at more length later.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: Pilot project using county parking lots for human habitation update: The chair said the item would be deferred for a longer discussion.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The mayor's homeless coordinator said the team is actively scouting sites but had nothing specific to report yet.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The chair said that without the ordinance, state law bars living in vehicles parked on public property between 6 p.m. and 6 a.m.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The committee chair said a 2022 ordinance created a pilot letting houseless people sleep in vehicles on chosen county property.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: A council member suggested a committee site visit to a Molokaʻi safe sleeping site.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee

timeline.text: The agenda had two items: an East Maui board appointment and a safe parking pilot update.
timeline.body: County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee
